description: This file provides a Rust wrapper around Android Binder objects, implementing the `Remotable` trait, managing native C++ `AIBinder` pointers, and facilitating service registration and transaction handling within the Android IPC framework.

classes.name: Binder
classes.description: A generic Rust wrapper around Android's native `AIBinder` object, managing its lifecycle and providing methods for stability, extension, and transaction handling.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new `Binder` instance with a default stability setting, taking ownership of a `Remotable` object.

methods.name: new_with_stability
methods.description: Creates a new `Binder` with specified stability, managing the lifetime of the `Remotable` object.

methods.name: set_extension
methods.description: Associates an extension binder with this binder, enabling interface extensions.

methods.name: get_descriptor
methods.description: Returns the interface descriptor string for the binder.

methods.name: mark_stability
methods.description: Sets the stability guarantee for the binder object.

methods.name: mark_local_stability
methods.description: Marks the binder as having local stability, differing based on build configuration.

methods.name: as_binder
methods.description: Converts the local `Remotable` object into a generic `SpIBinder` reference, incrementing its reference count.
